Right: the same nodes without the closing edge F–A (dashed), a path, where every pair has only one route and the average is 1.0." width="100%"} The local node connectivity of two nodes is the number of paths between them that share no other node (equivalently, how many other nodes must fail to separate them, plus one for a direct edge). Averaging it over all pairs (Beineke, Oellermann and Pippert, 2002) gives a finer measure of robustness than the global node connectivity, which only reports the weakest pair: two networks with the same weakest point can differ a lot in how well connected they are on average. Pairs are unordered on undirected graphs and ordered on directed graphs (paths follow edge direction). Parallel edges count once and self-loops are ignored. The value agrees with `node_connectivity_between()` averaged over pairs, and with NetworkX's `average_node_connectivity`. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The average local node connectivity (`0.0` for fewer than two nodes). ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} Each pair is one maximum flow in the usual auxiliary network: every node is split into an in-copy and an out-copy joined by a unit-capacity arc, and every edge becomes a unit-capacity arc from out-copy to in-copy. With $O(V^2)$ pairs, each solved by Dinic's algorithm, the method suits graphs of up to a few hundred nodes. ## Examples {.doc-examples} In a complete graph on five nodes, every pair has its direct edge plus three paths through the other nodes: ::: {#63b57eb3 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec ec.Graph().add_full_graph(5).average_node_connectivity() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 4.0 ``` ::: ::: A cycle has two disjoint routes between any pair, and a path only one: ::: {#2d5dfbdd .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} ( ec.Graph().add_cycle_graph(6).average_node_connectivity(), ec.Graph().add_path_graph(6).average_node_connectivity(), ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` (2.0, 1.0) ``` ::: :::
